transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. I'm Dr. Smith. To start, can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi, Dr. Smith. Um, well, I came in because I've been having these episodes where I just eat a lot, and... after it happens, I feel so gross and just really disappointed in myself. It's like I should have more control, you know? It gets to the point where I end up writing some pretty awful things about myself in my journal afterwards. I just want to figure out how to stop feeling like this.
After these episodes of eating a lot, do you ever try to make up for it—like making yourself vomit, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising excessively?

No, I don't do any of that. I don't make myself throw up or take laxatives, and I definitely don't exercise a bunch to make up for it or anything. I usually just kind of sit with it and feel terrible, honestly. But no, I don't try to physically undo it.
On average, how often do these binge-eating episodes happen, and how long has this pattern been going on?

For the past several months, it's been happening about once a week. Usually, there's at least one night a week where I end up buying way too much food after work and just... eat it all in one stretch. I can’t really remember a recent month where it stopped for more than a week or so. It's just been a pretty consistent pattern.
During these episodes, do you notice yourself eating much faster than usual, eating until you're uncomfortably full, or eating alone because you feel embarrassed about how much you're eating?

Yeah, I definitely notice the speed. I eat really fast during those times. I'll usually just be standing at the counter, or sitting on my bed with my sketchbook still open, and... I barely even taste anything, honestly. It's like I'm just trying to get it all down before I have a chance to think too much about what I'm doing.
During these episodes, do you feel like you can't stop eating or control what or how much you're eating, even if you want to?

Yeah, that's exactly how it feels. Once I start, it's like... I just keep reaching for the next thing, almost automatically. Even in my head, I'll be thinking, "Fumi, stop, you have sketches to finish," but... I don't actually stop. I just keep going until all the food is gone or I just feel way too uncomfortable to eat anymore. I really can't seem to control it once it starts.

latest_inference.note: Patient reports weekly binge episodes for several months, rapid eating, loss of control, eating until uncomfortably full, marked distress/self-criticism afterward, and explicitly denies any compensatory behaviors (vomiting, laxatives, fasting, excessive exercise). This pattern is consistent with binge-eating disorder, coded under F50.8 in ICD-10, and rules out bulimia nervosa (F50.2) given absence of compensatory behaviors.

final_diagnosis.reason: Patient reports recurrent binge-eating episodes (eating unusually large amounts of food in a discrete period, marked lack of control) occurring about once weekly for several months, accompanied by eating rapidly, eating until uncomfortably full, eating in isolation/secrecy, and significant subsequent guilt and self-disparagement.
